gameName: Robinson Crusoe: Adventures on the Cursed Island

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Robinson Crusoe rules (Portal Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: White marker on Morale level 0; black marker on the top space of the Weapon track
The 9 marked Invention cards plus 5 random ones faceup on the board; the rest as the Invention deck
The 3 Adventure decks shuffled facedown by their Action fields
Beast deck and Mystery deck shuffled facedown
Island tile 1 faceup on its space with the Camp token (Camp side up)
Black marker on the Shovel card over the beach terrain icon
Set up the chosen Scenario card and its pieces as it describes
Friday's card next to the board with the white Action pawn on it
Set up as for 2 players; also place the Dog's card next to the board with the purple Action pawn on it
You are always First Player; Shelter, Roof and Palisade cost the same as in the 2-player game

steps.note: Each ability can be used once per round; the number is its cost in Determination tokens.
details: Economical Construction (2): 1 less wood for one Action (can bring a cost to 0)
Craftsmanship (2): reroll any brown die in a Build Action
A New Idea (3): draw 5 Inventions, put 1 on the board, discard the rest
Handyman (3): an extra brown Action pawn this round, for his own Build Actions only
Grandma's Recipe (2 + 1 food): heal 2 wounds of one character or 1 each of two, at any time
Scrounger (2): reroll any grey die in a Gather Action
Stone Soup (3): gain 1 food
Hooch (3): ignore 1 rain cloud in the Weather Phase, or treat 1 snow cloud as rain
Lucky (2): reroll any green die in an Explore Action
Reconnaissance (2): look at the top 3 Island tiles, keep 1 on top and shuffle 2 back (before exploring)
Motivational Speech (3): morale +1
Scouting (3): draw 2 Discovery tokens, keep 1
Tracking (2): look at the top Hunting card, put it on the top or bottom
The Hunt (4): put the top Beast card unseen on top of the Hunting deck
Frenzy (3): +3 Weapon level during his Action
Defensive Plan (3): Palisade (if the Shelter is built) or Weapon level +1
Never First Player and not affected by Event cards
Can take any Action alone, or only support when paired with a player
A "?" on his Adventure die gives him 1 wound instead of an Adventure card
May spend 2 of his Determination tokens to reroll one of his dice

steps.text: Solo: morale goes up by 1 at the start of each Morale Phase
Life tracks: each time your Wound marker passes a Morale-decrease symbol, lower Morale by 1
Round 1 begins with the First Player
